meta.name: replay-learnings
meta.description: Surface past learnings relevant to the current task before starting work. Searches correction history, recalls past mistakes, and applies prior patterns. Use when starting a task, saying "what do I know about", "previous mistakes", "lessons learned", or "remind me about".

copy.tagline: 开始任务前自动回顾相关经验教训
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常因忘记历史错误而重复踩坑
copy.tagline_en: Surface relevant past learnings before starting a task
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat mistakes due to forgetting past lessons

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在开始任务前自动搜索过去的经验教训，并展示与当前任务最相关的学习记录、常见错误和修正建议。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新任务，或说出“what do I know about”、“previous mistakes”、“lessons learned”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 关于用户认证重构，我之前犯过什么错误？
say.note: Claude 会搜索相关学习记录并展示。

say.text: 开始之前，先回顾一下之前的教训。
say.note: Claude 会提取当前任务关键词并匹配学习记录。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will search past learnings before starting a task and present the most relevant records, common mistakes, and correction suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new task or saying "what do I know about", "previous mistakes", "lessons learned", etc.

say_en.text: What mistakes did I make before about user auth refactor?
say_en.note: Claude will search relevant learnings and display them.

say_en.text: Before I start, review past lessons.
say_en.note: Claude will extract keywords from the current task and match learnings.
